initial.proof_read: Elementary zero-anchor odd order lift sound: opposite diagonal residues sum to a multiple of n in [0,2M], hence vanish; invertibility of 2 forces exact zero in every cyclic root. Then every root coordinate is itself in B, and every pair remains below n. Explicit bound for dense reduction is distinct operative dependency. Sparse witness size injection uses one translate and includes repeats and singleton n=1. Need actual AFWS bounded reduction including v2 slips and literal OWR interpretation.

proof: For finite nonempty integer target, a root is also finite by injective translate and its extrema double. Parity and translation therefore normalize exactly. Under the odd lower-half promise, any pair witnessing zero gives diagonal residues summing to zero modulo n and less than n, so both are zero and the root contains zero. Every canonical root then lies in the prescribed target and no sums wrap. Empty, odd-minimum, zero-span and malformed branches have the required analogous fixed YES/NO exactly.

For sparse NP membership, one translate injects a root into its sumset, so witness length and all pair sums are polynomial in input bit length. The dense vector case accepts polynomial witness and computation because the n bits are explicit. Dense hardness follows separately by writing at most 2^58 q^4+1 bits under the credited bounded 3SAT compression, after relabeling occurring variables. It does not follow from arbitrary sparse length.
